text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
They're charging up the second slope
and around
the third corner! It's rough
going, but here's where
the race really
starts!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff... Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Come on, Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Goooo, Kitasaaan!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Who will prove themself stronger
between
Kitasan Black and Satono
Diamond?! The winner
is... Kitasan Black!
Kitasan Black secures another
victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wow... What a mind-blowing race... For
Kitasan
and Satono both.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Oh man, I've got goosebumps! It literally
gave me
chills!

text_block_list.name: Man in Hoodie
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, they both ran so well! What a
race!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Those two really brought it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You thinking what I'm thinking,
McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed I am. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... My legs... They're shaking...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Puff, puff... Hehe, mine too! I'm so tired I can barely stand!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's so frustrating... I gave it everything I
had...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I worked so hard to surpass my limits.

But I still couldn't win...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dia...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You beat me fair and square...
Congratulations on
your consecutive
wins, Kita.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but still... I was able to go beyond
my limits
because I had you pushing me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If I keep running with you, I'm sure I'll
become an
even greater runner!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I feel exactly the same way! Let's make
our way to
the top together!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! To the top, huh?! You say that
like it's
nothing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Do you realize who's waiting for you at
the top?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: T-Teio?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I reign here at the top! If you want up
here, you're
gonna have to go through
me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, Teio. Don't play it up too much.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Uh... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Consider this an official challenge from
the both
of us! McQueen and I will be
running in the fall!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You wanna get to the top, right? Then,
give us
your best shot!

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A-are you really going to run?! I-I hadn't
heard
anything about that...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That's correct. We weren't originally
planning on
running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, we have both changed our
minds after
observing your race today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We want to race against the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The way you ran today lit a fire in our
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What do you say? Do you accept our
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I would be honored to race
with both
of you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Me too! I gladly accept!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: That's what I like to hear!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll be running in the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And I will be running in the autumn
Tenno Sho. I
expect to see you both
there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
This is gonna be great! It's been too long
since I
ran in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, if you'll excuse us.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Am I dreaming, Dia? Pinch me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're not dreaming! That is, unless
we're both
having the same dream...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Omigooosh! This is really happening! We
get to
run against Teio!
choice_data_list: 俺も聞いていたから、夢じゃないよ
私も聞いていたから、夢じゃないよ
choice_data_list_en: I heard it too, so it wasn't a dream.
I heard it too, so it wasn't a dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And McQueen too! In the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy... To think this day would
come...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond trembles with passion
and her
eyes well up with tears. Kitasan
Black reacts much
the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's hardly surprising. They both entered
Tracen
Academy because they looked
up to Mejiro
McQueen and Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run in both the autumn Tenno
Sho and
the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I was planning on doing the Senior
Autumn Triple
Crown tour anyway. What
about you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in the autumn Tenno Sho!
I'd like to
run against McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That means she'd be running after
summer camp.
That might make training
difficult, considering
she doesn't do well
in the heat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm a little worried about making the
autumn
Tenno Sho her first race after
summer. It might be
wise to run another
race first to see how well she's
holding
up.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I have no objections. We can refine my
training
based on my performance there.
choice_data_list: その前に『京都大賞典』に出走しよう
choice_data_list_en: Before that, let's enter the Kyoto Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If the fans choose me for the Takarazuka
Kinen,
I'll run there first, and then the
autumn Tenno Sho
after!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's both do our best to beat McQueen
in the
autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wow... I still feel like I'm dreaming...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but I can't just sit on cloud nine.
This is my
chance to compete against
McQueen.
choice_data_list: だんだん実感が湧いてくるよ
choice_data_list_en: It'll gradually start to feel real.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Both McQueen and Teio are already
doing great
work as illustrious racers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to learn from them and figure out
what
being illustrious truly means for me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Especially McQueen. She bears the
weight of the
Mejiro name, so her
circumstances are quite
similar to mine.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As a representative of the Satono family,
I must
consider what kind of illustrious
runner I wish to
be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I promised to realize her dream of
becoming an
illustrious runner capable
of winning G1 races.
choice_data_list: 相談ならいつでものるから
choice_data_list_en: I'm always here if you need to talk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a trainer, there's only so much I can
do about
her future, but I want to help
her as much as I can.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm counting on you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Once I beat McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The Satono family's dream will finally
come true."
I finish the sentence for her
in my mind, feeling
the weight and
significance behind each word.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she can beat someone as distinguished
as
Mejiro McQueen, then she can
definitely call
herself an illustrious
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But before that, we have the Kyoto
Daishoten.
We can't afford any setbacks
in this warm-up
race.
